name: Run build

on:
    push:
        branches:
            - master
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - master

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v1
            - uses: actions/setup-node@v1
              with:
                  node-version: 18
            - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn run build

name: Run formatter

on:
    push:
        branches:
            - master
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - master

jobs:
    check-code-formatting:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v1
            - uses: actions/setup-node@v1
              with:
                  node-version: 18
            - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn run formatter

name: Run lint

on:
    push:
        branches:
            - master
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - master

jobs:
    run-tslint:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v1
            - uses: actions/setup-node@v1
              with:
                  node-version: 18
            - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn run tslint

{
    "name": "app-frontend",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "private": true,
    "dependencies": {
        "@ant-design/icons": "5.6.1",
        "@craco/craco": "^7.1.0",
        "@reduxjs/toolkit": "^2.8.2",
        "antd": "5.25.3",
        "axios": "^1.9.0",
        "caprover-api": "^0.0.24",
        "classnames": "^2.2.6",
        "deep-equal": "^2.0.5",
        "moment": "^2.29.1",
        "prettier": "^3.5.3",
        "qrcode": "^1.5.0",
        "react": "^18.2.0",
        "react-dom": "^18.2.0",
        "react-markdown": "^10.1.0",
        "react-redux": "^8.0.5",
        "react-router-dom": "^5.3.4",
        "react-scripts": "^5.0.1",
        "redux": "^4.0.5",
        "redux-thunk": "^3.1.0",
        "remark-gfm": "^4.0.1",
        "web-vitals": "^5.0.1",
        "yaml": "^2.8.0"
    },
    "scripts": {
        "formatter": "prettier --check './src/**/*.ts*'",
        "formatter-write": "prettier --write './src/**/*.ts*'",
        "tslint": "tslint -c tslint.json -p tsconfig.json",
        "tslint-fix": "tslint --fix -c tslint.json -p tsconfig.json",
        "start": "export NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider && craco start",
        "less-watch": "npx gulp watch",
        "build": "rm -rf ./build && export NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider && craco build",
        "test": "craco test",
        "test:e2e--open": "cypress open",
        "test:e2e": "cypress run",
        "eject": "react-scripts eject",
        "generate-locales": "node scripts/generate-locales.mjs && node scripts/find-untranslated.js",
        "populate-misssing-locales": "node scripts/populate-missing-translations.js"
    },
    "eslintConfig": {
        "extends": [
            "react-app",
            "react-app/jest"
        ]
    },
    "browserslist": {
        "production": [
            ">0.2%",
            "not dead",
            "not op_mini all"
        ],
        "development": [
            "last 1 chrome version",
            "last 1 firefox version",
            "last 1 safari version"
        ]
    },
    "devDependencies": {
        "@testing-library/dom": "^10.4.0",
        "@testing-library/jest-dom": "^6.6.3",
        "@testing-library/react": "^11.1.0",
        "@testing-library/user-event": "^14.6.1",
        "@types/classnames": "^2.3.4",
        "@types/deep-equal": "^1.0.4",
        "@types/jest": "^29.5.14",
        "@types/node": "^22.15.21",
        "@types/qrcode": "^1.4.2",
        "@types/react": "^18.2.22",
        "@types/react-dom": "^18.2.7",
        "@types/react-redux": "^7.1.31",
        "@types/react-router": "^5.1.20",
        "@types/react-router-dom": "^5.3.3",
        "@types/utf8": "^2.1.6",
        "cypress": "^14.4.0",
        "gulp-autoprefixer": "^9.0.0",
        "tslint": "^6.1.3",
        "tslint-config-prettier": "^1.18.0",
        "typescript": "^4.1.5"
    }
}

interface ProjectDefinition {
    id: string
    name: string
    description: string
    parentProjectId?: string
}

export default ProjectDefinition
